comments.author: FallegaHQ
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the feedback!

The menu “animation” is there to hide a technical limitation of SPT. Without it, the records button would appear a bit late. I will add a mod setting to toggle it in the next version.

Level toggling would require a lot more work. It might be coming in future versions but I can’t guarantee the time.

I am still collecting feedback in order to prioritise what to work on next.
